overloads.semanticRole: The RESIZE FORM WINDOW command lets you change the size of the current form window.

constraints: width/height are deltas (pixels to add), not absolute sizes; pass 0 to leave a dimension unchanged, or a negative value to shrink it.
Produces the exact same result as a manual resize via the resize box (when the window type allows resizing), so it still respects each object's resize properties and the form's size limitations.
